content.push(localize('chat.localModel.rows', "On-device models: when this device has an NVIDIA GPU that can run one, the model picker lists it in its On This Device tab, right after the Copilot tab, in Copilot chats that run on the local agent host. From the model list, use Left and Right Arrow to switch tabs and Up and Down Arrow to focus a model's row. Each model has a single row, like a cloud model's: its name, an Active badge while it is loaded or loading, and the effort level and context size, such as Medium and 128K. A screen reader also reads the model's state while it isn't ready, such as Downloading 42% or Not loaded; the detail page and the notice above the chat input show it too. Tab reaches the row's only button, labelled with the model's effort level and context size, or, for a model that isn't downloaded, Download (Set Up for model files already on this device), the download's progress, such as 42%, or Paused; it opens the model's detail page; Right Arrow on the row opens it too. Actions such as Retry, Pause, Resume, Download and Set Up are on the detail page, and those for a running, paused or failed step also in the notice above the chat input. Pause stops a download or update so it can be resumed later; Cancel takes back a model change, keeping the loaded model while the change waits for running responses, or stops loading a model, and Stop Now ends the responses a model change is waiting for. Once chosen, these read Pausing, Cancelling or Stopping and can't be chosen again until the model's state changes. A model that isn't downloaded can't be selected: a screen reader reads Not downloaded with its row, and Enter opens its detail page, which has its license, size and Download button. Enter on an installed model selects it and starts loading it right away, without asking. Only one on-device model is loaded at a time: selecting another one unloads the loaded one once its running responses finish, and the notice above the chat input shows how many responses it is waiting for, then the load, with Cancel."));

While a model downloads, its page shows a progress bar and the time remaining. An installed model's page has an Effort Level choice when the model supports it, which sets its effort level for this chat, like a cloud model's effort level, without reloading it; the row and the readout show the new level.
